name: response
sql: select d.sent_at, d.request_id, d.note, r.status_code, r.timed_out, r.error_msg, case when r.status_code between 200 and 299 then null else left(r.content, 600) end reply, r.headers->>'x-accepted-github-permissions' accepted_perms from public.postmatch_dispatch_log d left join net._http_response r on r.id=d.request_id order by d.sent_at desc limit 3

name: history
sql: select coalesce(r.status_code::text, case when r.id is null then 'no response' else 'err' end) status, count(*), min(d.sent_at), max(d.sent_at) from public.postmatch_dispatch_log d left join net._http_response r on r.id=d.request_id group by 1 order by 1

name: first_last
sql: select min(sent_at), max(sent_at), count(*) from public.postmatch_dispatch_log

name: alerts
sql: select condition, is_open, opened_at, last_sent_at from public.postmatch_alerts

name: alert_log_recent
sql: select at, condition, kind, delivered from public.postmatch_alert_log where at > now() - interval '3 hours' order by at
